description: Update the Olea verifier (Node/SAM) to the sourceId contract: drop all notary fields and the live-path notary import, add a registry-aware sourceId scope check in both submitEvidence and issueChallenge, bind sourceId (not tlsProofHash) into verifyNitroAttestation, keep buildManifest in lockstep with the enclave manifest, relocate the nonce binding off the notary module, and lock enclave<->verifier manifest parity with a test. Covers spec tasks 8, 9 and the code part of task 13. Contract-coupled to FEAT-002's binding/manifest shape; order it last so the manifest-parity fixture matches the settled enclave shape.
steps: In sam/olea/functions/verification/verification-contract.js: (a) rewrite buildManifest(body) to drop tlsProofType and tlsProofHash and replace source+endpoint with sourceId (keep requestId, evidenceId, sourceId, nonce, policyVersion, rawSourceHash, transformedHash, canonicalizationVersion, attestedPublicKeyBase64 in that order so sha256(canonicalize(buildManifest)) reproduces the enclave manifestDigest). (b) add and export validateNonceBinding(challenge, body, now=Date.now()) that is tlsProof-FREE: throw CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND if !challenge, CHALLENGE_REPLAY if challenge.used, CHALLENGE_EXPIRED if expired, NONCE_MISMATCH unless challenge.nonce === body.nonce. (c) leave validateTlsProof exported for the reference module but it is no longer called on the live path.

In sam/olea/functions/verification/index.js: (a) remove the require('./tlsnotary-verifier') line; import {validateNonceBinding} from './verification-contract' instead (add it to that destructure). (b) define a shared SOURCE_IDS = new Set(['getOrderMetrics','listFinancialEventGroups','listTransactions','alicloudTelThree','qichachaEnterpriseVerify','qichachaShixinCheck','gutuPanoramaChecks']). (c) submitEvidence required[]: remove tlsProofType,tlsProofHash,tlsProofResponseHash,tlsProof and replace 'source','endpoint' with 'sourceId'. (d) in submitEvidence replace the line 'if (body.source !== ... GET_ORDERS) throw SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID' with 'if (!SOURCE_IDS.has(body.sourceId)) throw new Error("SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID")'; DELETE the 'if (body.tlsProofType !== ...) throw TLS_PROOF_INVALID' line and the verifyTlsNotaryProof(...) call. (e) change the verifyNitroAttestation user_data arg object to {requestId: body.requestId, nonce: body.nonce, policyVersion: body.policyVersion, sourceId: body.sourceId, rawHash: body.rawPayloadDigest, transformedHash: body.transformedPayloadDigest, publicKey: body.attestedPublicKeyBase64} -- drop tlsProofHash, add sourceId, same order as the enclave binding. (f) keep the challenge endpointScope check working: since challenges are now sourceId-scoped, update the stored challenge.endpointScope usage accordingly OR gate on sourceId; keep NONCE/PCR/envelope/signature/same-bytes/202 intact.

In issueChallenge (index.js): change required to ['requestId','sourceId'] (drop endpoint/operation); replace the 'body.source !== mock-api || body.endpoint !== GET_ORDERS || !APPROVED_ENDPOINTS...' check with 'if (!SOURCE_IDS.has(body.sourceId)) return response(403, CHALLENGE_ENDPOINT_MISMATCH)'. Store sourceId on the challenge (e.g. challenge.sourceId and/or endpointScope=[body.sourceId]) so submitEvidence can confirm scope. Remove the now-unused APPROVED_ENDPOINTS constant if nothing else uses it.

Update sam/olea/functions/verification/index.test.js: assert the notary fields are no longer in submitEvidence's required set, that each of the 7 sourceIds passes the scope check and an unknown id is rejected with SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID, and that the user_data object built for verifyNitroAttestation has sourceId and no tlsProofHash. (Use direct function/unit assertions that do not require @aws-sdk at import time, matching the existing offline test style.)

Update sam/olea/functions/verification/verification-contract.test.js: change the sample body to the sourceId shape (replace source/endpoint with sourceId, remove tlsProofType/tlsProofHash), drop the two validateTlsProof tests (or move them to reference-only), and add validateNonceBinding tests (matching nonce ok; used -> CHALLENGE_REPLAY; expired -> CHALLENGE_EXPIRED; nonce diff -> NONCE_MISMATCH).

Create sam/olea/functions/verification/manifest-parity.test.js: build an enclave-shaped sample evidence body (sourceId contract), compute sha256(canonicalize(buildManifest(body))) and assert it equals a fixture digest produced by the SAME canonical rule the enclave uses (TreeMap sort + compact JSON over the identical manifest field set/order). Document in a comment how the fixture digest was produced so it is reproducible.

Task-13 code sweep: confirm (grep) index.js no longer imports ./tlsnotary-verifier and that the live path references no notary module. Do NOT delete tlsnotary-verifier.js, tlsnotary-verifier.test.js, the Rust sidecar, or coordinator/sources.py -- they remain as labeled reference. Do NOT modify any docs in this run.
acceptance_criteria: node --test in sam/olea/functions/verification passes with: notary fields absent from submitEvidence required[]; all 7 sourceIds accepted and an unknown id rejected (SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID); the verifyNitroAttestation user_data object has sourceId and no tlsProofHash.
buildManifest output contains sourceId and none of tlsProofType/tlsProofHash/source/endpoint; manifest-parity.test.js asserts the digest equals the enclave-rule fixture.
validateNonceBinding (in verification-contract.js) enforces matching/unexpired/single-use nonce without referencing tlsProof.
grep shows index.js has no require('./tlsnotary-verifier'); tlsnotary-verifier.js and coordinator/sources.py still exist on disk.
verification: cd sam\olea\functions\verification; node --test  -> all suites pass (pass count >= the pre-change 28 minus any intentionally removed notary tests, plus the new sourceId/nonce/parity tests; fail 0).
findings:
DONE. cd sam\olea\functions\verification; node --test = 36 tests, pass 36, fail 0 (baseline was 28; +8 new FEAT-004 tests across index.test.js/verification-contract.test.js/manifest-parity.test.js; the 2 old validateTlsProof tests were dropped and the 10 tlsnotary-verifier.test.js reference tests still run).

verification-contract.js: buildManifest now emits 9 entries {requestId, evidenceId, sourceId, nonce, policyVersion, rawSourceHash, transformedHash, canonicalizationVersion, attestedPublicKeyBase64} -- source+endpoint collapsed to a single sourceId in the same slot; tlsProofType/tlsProofHash removed. Added tlsProof-free validateNonceBinding(challenge, body, now=Date.now()): CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND / CHALLENGE_REPLAY (used) / CHALLENGE_EXPIRED / NONCE_MISMATCH (challenge.nonce !== body.nonce). validateTlsProof left exported for the reference module (no longer called on the live path).

index.js: removed require('./tlsnotary-verifier'); validateNonceBinding now imported from ./verification-contract. Added shared SOURCE_IDS = Set of the 7 ids (getOrderMetrics, listFinancialEventGroups, listTransactions, alicloudTelThree, qichachaEnterpriseVerify, qichachaShixinCheck, gutuPanoramaChecks). issueChallenge: required ['requestId','sourceId'], gates on !SOURCE_IDS.has(sourceId) -> 403 CHALLENGE_ENDPOINT_MISMATCH, stores challenge.sourceId and endpointScope=[sourceId]; APPROVED_ENDPOINTS removed; policy check no longer references body.endpoint. submitEvidence: required[] drops the 4 tlsProof* fields and source/endpoint, adds sourceId; scope gate is !SOURCE_IDS.has(body.sourceId) -> SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID; TLS_PROOF_INVALID line and verifyTlsNotaryProof call deleted; endpointScope check now uses body.sourceId. verifyNitroAttestation user_data binding is {requestId, nonce, policyVersion, sourceId, rawHash:rawPayloadDigest, transformedHash:transformedPayloadDigest, publicKey:attestedPublicKeyBase64} -- byte-identical to the enclave 7-key order, no tlsProofHash. same-bytes (rawResponseB64 decode -> rawPayloadDigest), PCR/release, envelope, Dowsure+enclave signatures, nonce binding and 202 path all intact.

manifest-parity.test.js: locks sha256(canonicalize(buildManifest(SAMPLE_BODY))) == 7e5b672dc1c80c4f3122e34fa6faaaa0f9ebe6e59974e285487447c9babe4793 against an independently derived enclave-rule canonical string (TreeMap key-sort + compact JSON over the identical 9-field set); reproduction documented in a comment.

Task-13 sweep: grep 'tlsnotary-verifier' in index.js = no matches; tlsnotary-verifier.js and coordinator/sources.py still exist on disk; no docs touched; the Rust sidecar untouched.
